notices.title: ADMINISTRATIVE UPDATE TO MARADMIN 189/26 POLICY ON SERVICE EXTENSIONS DURING INVOLUNTARY SEPARATION PROCESSING
notices.description: R 282011Z OCT 26MARADMIN 539/26MSGID/GENADMIN/CMC WASHINGTON DC MRA MP//SUBJ/ADMINISTRATIVE UPDATE
notices.summary: Service extensions are no longer allowed for Marines in involuntary administrative separation processing. A Marine who reaches EAS before proceedings finish will separate on the scheduled EAS.
notices.evidence: Marines currently being processed for involuntary administrative separation under reference (a) who reach their Expiration of Active Service (EAS) prior to the completion of separation proceedings will be separated on their scheduled EAS.

notices.title: FISCAL YEAR 27 VOLUNTARY ENLISTED EARLY RELEASE PROGRAM
notices.description: R 101303Z NOV 26MARADMIN 552/26MSGID/GENADMIN/CMC WASHINGTON DC MRA MP//SUBJ/FISCAL YEAR 27
notices.summary: Eligible active component FTAP enlisted Marines with an EAS in FY27 may request release up to 180 days early, or 90 days for listed specialties. Approval by the first GCMCA is not automatic.
notices.evidence: This message applies only to Active Component FTAP enlisted Marines with an EAS date between 1 January 2027 and 30 September 2027.
